name: Spaceship 938f9833 on 4.8.8
description: A period-4 spaceship on the truncated square tiling 4.8.8 (touching neighbours), 5 to 6 cells, moving two lattice steps every 4 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 256 rules from B2/S2 to B25678/S25678; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 406 times). Flagged as most likely already known: small (5 to 6 cells), common (seen 406 times) and wide-range (256 rules) on an Archimedean tiling. We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
